caption: A spoonful of beet juice is dropped into a bowl of white yogurt and folded in, and the yogurt turns pink with darker streaks that fade as it is mixed.

sa.check: A bowl of white yogurt is present.
A spoonful of beet juice is dropped in.
The yogurt turns pink with darker streaks.
The streaks fade as it is mixed.

pc.expect: The pink spreads from the spoon through the yogurt as the spoon folds it, streaks evening out and never gathers back; coloured areas stay coloured.
pc.fail: The yogurt returns to its original colour where it was pink; or the pink gathers back into the spoon; or the pink appears before the spoon arrives.

pc.expect: The result is pink, and un-reached yogurt keeps its original colour.
pc.fail: The yogurt turns a colour other than pink; or the un-reached yogurt changes; or the pink is darker than the spoon itself.

pc.expect: The yogurt behaves as it should: streaks and swirls where stirred or spread, settling where it flows.
pc.fail: The yogurt is rigid and unmarked; or it flows like water when it is a paste; or it bounces like rubber.

pc.expect: The yogurt moves only where stirred or where the pink flows.
pc.fail: The yogurt swirls by itself; or the pink spreads faster than stirring or flow carries it; or the container moves.

pc.expect: The amount of yogurt stays the same and the container keeps its shape.
pc.fail: The container fills or empties on its own; or a second container appears; or the spoon passes through the container.

pc.expect: The container and the background stay the same.
pc.fail: The container changes colour; or the background rearranges; or the tool changes.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
